split_note: Cyber sweep plus displacement: jobs or recovery.

situation.title: Major Cyber Incident
situation.description: A large, largely automated attack lands. Its form is chosen at the time – a ransomware sweep across public services, a compromised software dependency with an unknown blast radius, or disruption of infrastructure directly – and severity scales with how far offensive capability has outrun defence. Damage is real and public, defenders are visibly behind, and attribution takes months. Whoever ran it, the tooling was model-generated.

situation.title: Capability Jump
situation.description: A discontinuous advance is released or demonstrated. Everything written about deployment timelines the week before is obsolete. It moves `ai_capability` by roughly +3 to +7 and costs `ai_safety` on the terms of metric rule 3.

situation.title: Labour Displacement Wave
situation.description: Measurable job losses attributed to AI in named sectors, with the graduate market worst hit: entry-level positions in law, accountancy, software, customer operations and administration are not replaced. The numbers are argued about; the absence of hiring is not.

situation.title: Export Control Escalation
situation.description: Chip and model export controls tighten again. Either allied buyers keep access on volume licences while everyone else is cut off, or the controls are drawn so tightly that allies are rationed alongside adversaries – decide which at the time from the standing American posture and from what the Union has built.

measure: Targeted Transition Income and Tier-One Retraining for Checkable Work
